chunks: My father narrated (may God be pleased with him), saying: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated from Ahmad ibn Ishaq ibn Sa'd, from Bakr ibn Muhammad al-Azdi, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said: The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said:

I had ten characteristics from the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family), each of which would please me more than everything upon which the sun shines. He said: You are my brother in this world and the Hereafter, and you are the closest of people to me in standing position on the Day of Resurrection. Your house is opposite my house in Paradise, just as brothers face each other for the sake of God. You are the holder of my flag in this world and the Hereafter. You are my Trustee, my inheritor, and my Caliph over my Household, my property, and the Muslims in every absence. Your intercession is my intercession. Your friend is my friend, and my friend is the friend of God. Your enemy is my enemy, and my enemy is the enemy of God.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (title for Imam Ali)
key_terms.الْغَيْبَةِ: The absence/occultation (referring to periods of Imam Ali's or the Imams' absence)
key_terms.مَوْقِفًا: Standing position (on the Day of Judgment)

ai.seo_question: What are the ten virtues of Imam Ali mentioned in al-Khisal?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Khisal* encapsulates the Shia doctrine of *Nass* (designation) and *Wilayah*, establishing Ali ibn Abi Talib as the spiritual and political successor through ten distinct honors. It highlights the metaphysical bond of brotherhood (*Mubahala* context) and the continuity of authority (*Khilafah*) during the Prophet's absence, reinforcing the concept of *Tawalli* and *Tabarri* (loyalty and enmity) as a divine principle. The narration underscores that Ali's status is not merely honorary but constitutive of the Prophet's own identity in the hereafter.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 10-9 (The compiler of the book narrated) that his father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Sa’ed ibn Abdullah quoted Ahmad ibn Ishaq ibn Sa’ed, on the authority of Bakr ibn Muhammad al-Azodi, on the authority of some companions, on the authority of Aba Abdullah as-Sadiq (MGB) that the Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali (MGB) said,

“I have ten characteristics of the Prophet of God (MGB) each of which would please me more than everything upon which the sun shines. God’s Prophet (MGB) told me, ‘(O Ali!). You are my brother in this world and the Hereafter. You are going to be the closest person to me standing at the Threshold of the Omnipotent on the Resurrection Day. Your house and myhouse will be facing each other in Paradise just like two brothers’ houses. You are the one to uphold my flag in this world and the Hereafter. You are my Trustee; my inheritor the Caliph reigning over my Household and property. Your intercession would be my intercession. Your friends are my friends. My friends are considered to be God’s friends. Your enemies are my enemies. My enemies are considered to be God’s enemies.’”
